story.title: About 6th ANNUAL ASHLAND CITY HALF-MARATHON
paragraphs: Nashville Track Club is excited to bring you the 6th annual Ashland City Half-Marathon on Saturday, March 7, 2026. This race is a USA Track & Field-sanctioned event. It will take place on a fast, flat, USATF-certified course that starts and finishes next to the Cumberland River at Riverbluff Park in Ashland City, TN.

Online registration is available on the official registration page. Entry fee is $60 until 11:59pm Wednesday December 31, 2025. $70 until 11:59pm Saturday, January 31. After that, it will increase to $80. Online registration is open until 07:00am on Saturday, March 7 (race day). You may also enter in person on race day between 5:45am and 7:15am. Each participant will receive a Next Level race T-shirt and more swag to be announced as sponsorships firm up. All finishers will receive a medal.

In 2022, the course had to be redesigned, re-measured, and re-certified due to construction on Tennessee Waltz Parkway east of Riverbluff Park. The 2025 course is identical to the one used the last three years — beautiful, flat, and very fast. The course’s USATF certification number is TN22002MS. This course is eligible for Tennessee single-age state records.

We will have crewed aid stations — offering both water and Gatorade — at the following points on the course: 3.3 miles, 4.4 miles, 7.3 miles, 9.3 miles, and 11.5 miles. We will not be handing out gels, so if you plan to use gels, please bring your own. In the unlikely occurrence of a medical emergency during the event, each aid station will have a direct line to EMS.

We will conduct awards and the post-race celebration at Sidelines Bar & Grill at 11:00am (they will open early at 10:30am). All registered participants will receive one drink ticket for a complimentary beverage upon arrival — you must show your bib number to receive your drink ticket.

faqs.question: What is the refund or transfer policy?
faqs.answer: In the event that you are unable to take part in the race, refunds will NOT be issued. However, bibs may be transferred up to 5pm Wednesday March 4th, and you can have a friend pick up your T-shirt.

faqs.question: What do participants receive?
faqs.answer: Each participant will receive an incredibly soft Next Level race T-shirt and more swag to be announced as sponsorships firm up. All finishers will receive a medal.

faqs.question: Where is packet pick-up?
faqs.answer: Packet pick-up is available at Nashville Running Company at 820 Woodland St, Nashville, TN 37206 from 11am – 6pm on Friday, March 6. You can also pick up your packet at Athlete Registration between 5:45am – 7:15am on race morning (Saturday, March 7) at Riverbluff Park in Ashland City.

faqs.question: Is there a course time limit?
faqs.answer: The course is open for 3 hours.

faqs.question: Are awards or prize money listed?
faqs.answer: Prizing is listed as follows: male and female overall awards are 1st — $300, 2nd — $200, and 3rd — $100. A $250 course-record bonus is listed, with masters and age-group awards also noted by the source page.
